_comment: keel hooks reference for Pi Agent. Pi Agent's core does not expose a hook lifecycle comparable to Claude Code or Codex, but supports hook-like behavior through extensions (pi-autohooks, pi-shepherd). This file documents what keel hooks provide and how to trigger equivalent behavior via the keel CLI, MCP tools, or pi-autohooks.

SessionStart.description: Loads the keel bootstrap skill, injects workspace digest, and resolves memory scope at session start.
SessionStart.manualTrigger: Run the keel memory command at the start of your first prompt in a session.
SessionStart.timing: Once per session, before first prompt

UserPromptSubmit.description: Restates the iron law research-first rules on every prompt. Injects a short context brief.
UserPromptSubmit.manualTrigger: The AGENTS.md file loaded at startup serves the same purpose -- the iron law is always present in context.

PreToolUse.description: Intercepts noisy shell commands and reruns them through the keel compaction proxy to prevent raw output from filling context.
PreToolUse.manualTrigger: Instead of running raw shell commands, use keel run -- <command> or the MCP run_command tool.

PostToolUse.description: Records tool execution observations for memory and learning.
PostToolUse.manualTrigger: No manual trigger needed. Observations are recorded when using MCP tools.

PreCompact.description: Refreshes the workspace SYSTEM_MAP before context compaction to preserve structural awareness.
PreCompact.manualTrigger: When Pi Agent compacts context, manually refresh the system map: keel memory system-map refresh

PostCompact.description: Records a learning checkpoint after compaction to capture state for recovery.
PostCompact.manualTrigger: After compaction, search memory for context: keel memory recall <topic>

Stop.description: Turn-end checkpoint that records completion state and learning.
Stop.manualTrigger: At the end of a work session, check memory status: keel memory status

PostToolBatch.description: Injects a reviewer-on-close reminder before the next model turn.
PostToolBatch.manualTrigger: Before finishing a code change, run: keel review pre-commit --format compact
PostToolBatch.timing: Before each next model turn after tool use

workflowCommands.description: keel workflow commands that Pi Agent users can run directly via bash or the MCP cli tool.
